purpose: Replace process-local default mocks with tenant-scoped PostgreSQL IntegrationBinding state and establish the canonical server-evidence-backed integration capability maturity authority.
requiredInvariants: IntegrationBinding state, version and evidence are PostgreSQL-authoritative and tenant-scoped.
The only transport vocabulary is REST, WEBHOOK, 1C, SFTP, FILE, DEEPLINK, PLATFORM_UI and MANUAL.
IntegrationBinding maturity uses the canonical eleven-stage ladder from DISCOVERED through LIVE_ACCEPTED with DEGRADED and SUSPENDED operational states.
Organization, tenant, membership, provider ownership, status and maturity are derived server-side.
Organization administrators may declare opaque binding references only into PENDING_VERIFICATION; they cannot write maturity evidence or activate a binding.
LIVE_ACCEPTED requires a complete evidence chain and a receipt issued by the external provider; platform-issued receipts never count.
PostgreSQL FORCE RLS denies cross-tenant access and grants application principals SELECT-only evidence access.
CAS versioning, advisory serialization and payload-bound idempotency protect every binding mutation.
Binding mutation, append-only event, chained audit and outbox rows commit in one transaction.
Importing the integration registry never makes a mock adapter callable; stubs require explicit configuration.
No registration path, Deal Engine change, paid dependency, external partner access or production activation is introduced.
acceptance: An organization administrator can declare each of the eight binding transports, including MANUAL for a provider without an API.
Binding reads redact endpoint and credential references and derive maturity only from server-held evidence.
Exact replay returns the original receipt and a changed payload under the same key is rejected.
Concurrent commands using the same expected version produce one commit and one stale-version result.
Application principals cannot insert integration capability evidence or self-activate a binding.
A complete contiguous evidence chain plus an external receipt is required for LIVE_ACCEPTED and real-traffic admission.
Unset adapter modes fail closed and explicit stub mode is the sole route to a mock adapter.
A forced audit or outbox failure rolls back binding state and the append-only event.
The scope guard confirms no registration or role-eligibility path changed.
